User Stories: As a Guest, I want to create a Registered User account. I attempted registration using valid data.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall create the account, assign the User role, and display a registration confirmation (FR-1.1).
Steps to Test:
1. Open FitFusion AI
2. Click Register
3. Select role = User
4. Enter valid Full name, email, password
5. Click Register

User Stories: As a Guest, I want to register as a Seller. I selected the Seller role.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall require a Store Name when Seller role is selected; registration blocked without it (FR-1.1).
Steps to Test:
1. Click Register
2. Select role = Seller
3. Leave Store Name blank, attempt submit
4. Enter Store Name, submit

User Stories: As a Guest, I want to register. I attempted with a weak password (no special character).
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall enforce 8+ chars, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 number, 1 special char in real time and block registration until satisfied (FR-1.5).
Steps to Test:
1. Click Register
2. Enter password "Passw0rd" (no special char)
3. Attempt submit

Access Type / Pre-Condition: An account with the email already exists
User Stories: As a Guest, I want to register. I attempted with an email that is already registered.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall inform the user the account already exists and suggest using different info or logging in (UC-07 ext 5b).
Steps to Test:
1. Click Register
2. Enter an existing email
3. Fill remaining valid data
4. Click Register

User Stories: As a Guest, I want to register. I attempted without providing an email.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall identify missing required fields and prompt completion (UC-07 ext 3a).
Steps to Test:
1. Click Register
2. Leave email blank
3. Fill other fields
4. Click Register

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to access my account. I attempted login with valid credentials.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall validate credentials, verify the password hash, generate a JWT with role, and redirect to dashboard (UC-08, FR-1.6).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Login page
2. Enter valid email and password
3. Click Login

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to access my account. I attempted login with an incorrect password.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall display "Invalid email or password" and not log the user in (UC-08 ext).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Login page
2. Enter valid email + wrong password
3. Click Login

User Stories: As a user, I want to access my account. I attempted login with an unregistered email.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall display an invalid-credentials error and deny access (UC-08 ext).
Steps to Test:
1. Open Login page
2. Enter an email never registered
3. Enter any password
4. Click Login

User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to log out of my account.
Acceptance Criteria: After logout, the application shall clear the user's local authentication and session state. The user shall be unable to access protected pages or perform protected actions until logging in again (FR-1.6).
Steps to Test:
1. Log in as a Registered User.
2. Open a protected page.
3. Click Logout.
4. Use the browser Back button and attempt to reopen the protected page.
5. Attempt a protected action.
6. Verify access is denied and the user is returned to a public page.

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Registered account with presets, outfits, and orders exists
User Stories: As a Registered User, I want to delete my account.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall mark the account archived and deactivate it in place immediately (blocking login/RBAC), and after the grace period purge active PII and retain only a restricted pseudonymized archive (FR-1.4, RA 10173).
Steps to Test:
1. Log in
2. Navigate to Account Management
3. Click Delete Account
4. Confirm
5. Attempt login again
6. Trigger/verify stage-2 cold archival and confirm active collections have no PII while accounts_archiveduser/accounts_order are pseudonymized (Carlos)

User Stories: As a user, I want my password securely stored.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall hash passwords using Argon2id or PBKDF2; no plaintext passwords stored (Criterion 7).
Steps to Test:
1. Register a new user.
2. Query MongoDB Atlas users collection.
3. Inspect the password field hash prefix.

User Stories: As a Guest, I want my data discarded when I close the tab.
Acceptance Criteria: The system shall not write Guest avatar, rating, or session data to the persistent DB (FR-1.9).
Steps to Test: 1. Continue as Guest. 2. Create avatar and equip an item. 3. Close tab.4. Query DB for orphaned guest records.

User Stories: As a user, I want my data isolated from others.
Acceptance Criteria: Server-side access control shall prevent User B from reading User A's orders and avatar presets. User B shall receive an access-denied or not-found response, and no User A data shall be disclosed (FR-1.7; FR-2.8; FR-6.7; FR-6.8).
Steps to Test:
1. Log in as User A and record an Order ID and an Avatar Preset ID.
2. Log out and log in as User B.
3. Attempt to view User A's order using the application or the corresponding API request.
4. Attempt to view User A's avatar preset using the application or the corresponding API request.
5. Verify both requests are denied or return not found, and neither response exposes User A's data.

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Not logged in; catalog items available
User Stories: As a Guest, I want to explore FitFusion AI without registering or logging in.
Acceptance Criteria: Clicking “Continue as Guest” shall open the Guest dashboard. The Guest shall be able to access catalog browsing, avatar creation, virtual try-on, and recommendations without registering or logging in.
Steps to Test:
1. Open FitFusion AI.
2. Click Continue as Guest.
3. Verify that the Guest dashboard opens.
4. Browse the catalog.
5. Open avatar creation and create an avatar.
6. Try on a catalog item.
7. View recommendations.
8. Verify that registration or login is not required for these features.

Access Type / Pre-Condition: Guest session active; catalog items available
User Stories: As a Guest, I want to receive a sign-up/login prompt when attempting actions that require a registered account.
Acceptance Criteria: When a Guest attempts Add to Cart, Checkout, Save Outfit, or clicks an in-app rating control, the system shall block the action, save/cache nothing, and display a sign-up/login prompt (FR-1.8, FR-5.4, FR-6.1, FR-7.5).
Steps to Test: 1. Continue as Guest. 2. Attempt to add an item to the cart. 3. Attempt to access Checkout. 4. Equip clothing and attempt to save the outfit. 5. Verify that each restricted action displays the sign-up/login prompt and does not complete. 6. Verify through unauthenticated API requests that the backend denies protected actions. 7. Check the database to confirm that no Guest cart item, order, or saved outfit was created.
